text:
[Council File 19-1308-S1]
City Administrative Officer report relative to an amendment to an agreement with electric vehicle (EV) Charging Solutions to modify equipment specifications, clarify utility reimbursements, and add sites for operation.
(This item was referred to Energy and Environment Committee and Transportation Committee. On August 12, 2026, the Transportation Committee approved this item.)
Fiscal Impact Statement:
Yes
Financial Policies Statement:
Yes
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
TIME LIMIT FILE - AUGUST 23, 2026
(LAST DAY FOR COUNCIL ACTION - AUGUST 21, 2026)
summary: City Council approves amendment to EV charging infrastructure agreement with EV Charging Solutions to modify equipment specifications and add sites.

outcome.text: Energy and Environment Committee concurred with the Transportation Committee action of August 12, 2026 to approve this item (Aug 18, 2026); Council adopted item forthwith (Aug 21, 2026); Council action final
